jobs.description:
About Octarine Bio

Octarine Bio is a Copenhagen-based company pioneering a new generation of sustainable, bio-based colourants. We engineer nature-inspired colours that deliver the performance, stability, and safety profile required for demanding industrial applications while decoupling colour from fossil-based chemistry. PurePalette™ is supplied as a formulated product, ready to use in textiles, plastics, paper, and more.

Designed for drop-in integration and targeting price parity with conventional colourants, PurePalette™ lets customers adopt a more sustainable solution without compromising cost, quality, or scalability.

The Role

As a Technical Sales Manager, you will own the commercial relationships that take PurePalette™ from sample to qualified supply. You will identify and develop new customers across multiple regions and application segments. You will guide customers through the full sales process, from the technical evaluation that industrial colourants require — sampling, trials, and qualification on their own equipment — to supply agreement execution.

This is a hands-on role in a company at an early commercial stage. You will work closely with technical and commercial teams to understand customer needs and bring learnings in the field into product selection and development. As volumes grow, you will also help build the order fulfilment and logistics processes that reliable supply depends on.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable holding technical conversations with engineers and commercial conversations with purchasing managers, and who is motivated by building something new.

Key Responsibilities

• Identify, qualify, and develop new customers & key accounts across target markets and regions

• Manage sample and trial programmes from first request through to qualification on customer equipment

• Present PurePalette™ to technical and commercial audiences, from process engineers to purchasing and sustainability teams

• Understand customer applications and requirements, and work with R&D and application scientists to match them to the right formulation

• Prepare quotations and proposals, and negotiate supply agreements

• Build and maintain relationships with customers, distributors, and partners

• Maintain accurate opportunity and account information in the CRM

• Represent Octarine Bio at trade shows and industry events, and feed market and competitor intelligence back to the business

• Deliver on revenue and growth targets, and help shape our commercial strategy

Qualifications & Experience

Required

• 5+ years in technical sales, business development, or application support in an industrial B2B setting

• Strong ability to deliver a technical sales presentation, to hold a credible technical conversation and to translate it into a commercial one

• Willingness to travel for customer visits and trade shows

• Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage

• Curious, proactive, well organized, and comfortable owning a sales pipeline

Preferred

• Experience in colourants, pigments, dyes, inks, coatings, or textile chemicals

• Familiarity with how industrial customers qualify a new raw material — sampling, trials, and regulatory or restricted substance screening

• Experience selling a novel or sustainability-positioned product into cost-sensitive markets

• Working knowledge of the operational side of sales, e.g., order fulfillment, warehousing, shipping, and export documentation

Why work with us

Octarine Bio is located in central Copenhagen – one of Europe’s most liveable cities – in a country world-renowned for its exceptional quality of life and work-life balance. As a biosolutions scale-up, our team members have a high degree of autonomy, and their decisions and daily work have a direct, measurable impact on the company’s success. We offer a competitive salary and an international, collaborative working environment.

How to apply

Please submit to stephanie@octarinebio.com your CV along with a short cover letter explaining your relevant technical and commercial experience and why you would like to join Octarine Bio.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

About Us: Knowledge Gate Group is dedicated to accelerating scientific research by using cutting-edge artificial intelligence to streamline manual processes in the scientific industry. Role Description: We're looking for a proactive, relationship-driven Account Manager to help us build something new. You will be responsible for building your own pipeline from scratch, winning new business, and growing accounts over time. This role is a mix of hunting and relationship management, but it starts with hunting.

Your main focus will be building out our client-base within life science and pharmaceuticals, both directly with pharma companies and via market research and consultancy firms. That means a big part of your day-to-day will be outbound prospecting, and getting meetings on the calendar, as well as taking meetings booked by SDRs. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love building relationships, earning commission and get energy from creating opportunities where none existed before, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Own the full sales cycle from first outreach to close, and then account growth

• 
Build and manage your pipeline from scratch through cold calling, outbound outreach, and consistent follow-up, working closely with SDRs where relevant to close new opportunities

• 
Act as the main point of contact for clients and active opportunities, ensuring a smooth and high-quality experience

• 
Collaborate closely with the fulfillment team to ensure timely and successful delivery of solutions

Identify opportunities for upselling KGG’s services and expanding our footprint within client organizations

Track pipeline and account activity, gather feedback, and ensure retention through strong service and communication

• 
Prepare and deliver reports, presentations, and proposals as needed to support client success and internal alignment

What We’re Looking For:

• 
3+ years of experience in sales, account management, or client success, preferably in knowledge services, professional services, or within pharma/life sciences

• 
A builder mindset. You like starting from zero, creating momentum, and owning your number

• 
Comfortable doing outbound every day, including cold calling, and staying consistent even when it takes time to break through

• 
Strategic thinker with a client-first mindset and a drive to grow business relationships

• 
Extremely organized and detail-oriented. You keep things moving, nothing slips through the cracks, and your inbox is always under control

• 
Highly responsive and proactive. You don’t wait to be asked, and you never leave a client waiting

• 
A strong communicator, both written and verbal, comfortable engaging with clients across different time zones, cultures, and seniority levels

Why Join KGG?

• 
Accelerated career growth. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact. You won’t be stepping into an existing playbook. You’ll help build the pipeline and get real credit for the results

• 
A dynamic and engaging environment with a diverse international team

• 
Opportunity to make your mark in a fast-evolving company at the forefront of decentralized science

• 
Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives

• 
Flexible work environment and support for professional development

Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?

Use the Apply button to submit your application. We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Juul - DESMI at rasj@desmi.com.

**Summary

**At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

**Description

**We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable.

The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

**Responsibilities

**

• Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

**Job Description

**

We are looking for an OFCI (Owner Furnished Contractor Installed) Project Manager, responsible for ensuring that all activities in regard to the owner furnished equipment (that is purchased by the client), are executed in a qualitative and timely manner. A key role within the organization, you will be the client’s representative overseeing the entirety of the OFE (Owner Furnished Equipment) / FIA (Field Integrated Assembly) activities, working with different stakeholders (client sourcing departments and contractors on the project) and updating the project team on advancements and potential bottlenecks.

• Managing OFE; monitoring and reporting on vendor and integrator off site activities, ensuring alignment with project objectives and client strategies.

• Performing in depth contract and scope of work reviews with gap analysis, ensuring all contractual scope is covered between the vendors and site contractors teams.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across various client departments and contractors to gather requirements, manage expectations, and address concerns proactively.

• Provide regular (weekly) progress updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparent communication and fostering trust throughout the project lifecycle.

• Manage OFE schedules, tracking milestones and timelines to guide project execution effectively. Ensuring ROS (required on site) dates correlate between schedule and vendors.

• Swiftly resolve issues, blockers and conflicts that may arise during project execution, demonstrating strong problem-solving abilities and a communicative supporting work ethic.

• Structure the complex work interfaces with ease and simplicity showing effective ways of working and managing activities and stakeholders across the critical PM categories of: Scope, Time, Cost and Quality.

This role will require a large degree of on-site presence, with some flexibility to be agreed upon.

**Qualifications

**

• Minimum of 3 years in Supply chain coordinator (or OFCI) and / or Project Management capacity working on complex, large scale projects. Data Center Industry experience is preferred.

• Experience in Construction / Engineering, preferably Mechanical & Electrical, or equivalent industry experience.

• Ability to manage multiple vendors and coordinate across teams.

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Superb communication skills in English – with Danish as a nice to have.

• Proactive, efficient, and problem-solving PM mentality.

• Strong knowledge of supply chain processes, customs regulations, and construction logistics for critical Data Center equipment (or similar industrial equipment).

• Proficiency in EDMS systems (ACC is preferred) and project management tools.

**Additional Information

**

**What We Offer:

**

• Exciting work in an international environment.

• Independent work with challenging tasks.

• International development perspectives and training opportunities.

• Employer-funded pension plan.

• Modern workplace in centrally located offices with good transport connections.

We are looking forward to your application!

ViroGates is a NASDAQ First North-listed MedTech company headquartered in Birkerød, Denmark. We develop suPAR, a biomarker that reflects immune system activation and helps guide healthcare professionals.

Role Description

Our marketing team is growing. Alongside colleagues focused on content/social and UX/website design, we're looking for a third working student to take ownership of the technical and performance aspects of our marketing: keeping the website running and improving it, building out digital campaigns, and helping us reach healthcare professionals across Europe and beyond.

You'll work hands-on from day one, with room to test ideas and see the results.

What you'll do

Website

• 
Help maintain and update our WordPress site, in close cooperation with our UX/design student

• 
Implement tracking, landing pages, and forms

• 
Monitor performance in analytics and flag what's working and what isn't

• 
Support our SEO/AI scan to improve organic visibility

Email & automation

• 
Build and send newsletters and campaign emails

• 
Set up automated flows (welcome journeys, follow-ups, lead nurturing)

• 
Maintain lists and segmentation, and report on open, click, and conversion rates

Paid campaigns

• 
Set up and manage paid campaigns on relevant platforms (Google Ads, LinkedIn, etc.)

• 
Support with audience targeting, ad variants, and budget monitoring

What you bring

• 
Enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree program, ideally in marketing, communication, business, digital media, or something related - but we care more about interest than subject

• 
A good understanding of digital marketing tools and channels, especially relevant social media and paid advertising

• 
Structured and reliable - you'll own deadlines

• 
English speaker at a professional level

Nice to have, not required: experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, or WordPress; understanding of SEO; basic coding knowledge.

What we offer

• 
15-20 hours per week, with flexible hours to accommodate your studies and exams

• 
Free transportation ("pendlerkort") to our office in Birkerød at Banevænget 13, located right next to the train station

• 
A friendly, less hierarchical, and collaborative work environment where we are all working together with a common goal

• 
Option to gain practical experience in international marketing and communications in the MedTech sector

• 
Competitive salary and the chance to make a significant impact in a growing company

How to apply

• 
If this sounds like the perfect fit for you, please apply by submitting your CV via LinkedIn. We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. For any questions, contact Alex Delatour, VP of Business Development, at ade@virogates.com.

Key responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

• KPI / Dashboard Development / Support

• Ad Hoc Tasks

Suggested candidate profile

Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Are you passionate about developing software and curious about how software powers modern factories? Would you like to work with cloud-based solutions for our factories in Denmark and the USA? Are you ready for an exciting and educational internship in an international high-tech company?

Here is what the job entails

As an intern in our Manufacturing Software team, you will have a wide range of tasks in the entire software development process from specification, design, and implementation, through to review, testing, deployment, and monitoring. You will be part of a team, where you will be introduced to all facets of the work as a software developer.

In the position, you will work with a wide range of technologies, including:

• NET 5+ and .NET Framework

• Blazor, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML5

• Azure: App Services, Application Insights, Functions, Traffic Manager

• Databases: Cosmos DB, MS SQL Server, SQLite

• XUnit, AutoFixture, Moq, FluentAssertions

• Kubernetes Services

• GitHub Copilot

As our Intern, you will gain hands-on experience with the end-to-end software development process. Furthermore, you will be a trusted member of the team where you will be given responsibility for your own tasks, depending on your competencies and interests.

Meet your future team

As an intern, you will be part of our Manufacturing Software team, which is part of our Supply Chain Development department. The team consists of 8 developers and specialists who all work to develop Kamstrup’s manufacturing platform to ensure that our production runs optimally. We foster a supportive and collaborative atmosphere, where you will work on equal footing with your colleagues while also being supported by your own mentor throughout the internship. Moreover, we have an open and inclusive culture where everyone is encouraged to bring their perspectives and ideas.

Did you know? We have a physicist and a board game enthusiast in the department.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a dedicated intern who is eager to put their theoretical knowledge into practice. You have a proactive approach to your work and are ready to contribute to the team’s success by bringing your ideas and perspectives into our professional discussions.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying for a degree in Software Technology (ICT), Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field

• Are a quick learner and open to new technologies and working methods

• Have a strong sense of responsibility, both for your own projects and for shared projects

• Stay updated with the latest knowledge in your field and are passionate about turning it into sustainable solutions

• Are curious about how AI can be applied in our products as well as your daily work

As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English. Proficiency in Danish is considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

jobs.occupation: Product Manager – AI | Shape the Future of Construction Tech with Dalux
jobs.description:
**Product Management at Dalux – Bringing AI into the Construction Industry

**Dalux continues to grow rapidly, and AI is creating entirely new possibilities for how construction professionals find information, understand complex project data, automate repetitive work, and make decisions.

We're looking for an AI Product Manager to help turn those possibilities into products that create real value for our users.

As an AI Product Manager at Dalux, you'll operate at the intersection of customer needs, rapidly evolving AI technology, and business strategy. You'll work closely with Product Design, AI engineers, developers, and other Product Managers to identify where AI can meaningfully improve construction workflows – and equally importantly, where it cannot.

Building AI products is different from traditional software development. Outputs are probabilistic, quality needs continuous evaluation, and product decisions involve trade-offs between accuracy, latency, cost, scalability, and user trust.

You'll help us navigate those trade-offs and establish how we build great AI products at Dalux.

**Your responsibilities will include:

**

• AI Product Discovery: Identify and validate problems where AI can create meaningful value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

• Customer Insights: Work closely with users and internal domain experts to understand construction workflows and identify opportunities for AI-powered improvements.

• Evaluation & Quality: Define what "good" looks like for AI features and establish evals, quality metrics, test cases, and feedback loops.

• AI Safety & Trust: Consider hallucinations, uncertainty, guardrails, failure modes, explainability, and user trust throughout product development.

• Feature Ownership: Lead AI-powered features from early experimentation and prototyping through delivery, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

• Technical Collaboration: Work closely with AI engineers and developers on model capabilities, context, architecture, latency, scalability, and cost.

• AI Product Strategy: Follow developments in models and AI technology and help determine which technological advances create meaningful opportunities for Dalux.

**About You

**We are looking for someone who combines strong product thinking with a solid understanding of modern AI.

You don't need to be an AI engineer, but you need enough technical understanding to make informed product decisions and have meaningful discussions with the engineers building these systems.

We believe you:

• Have experience building or managing customer-facing AI/ML products.

• Understand concepts such as LLMs, RAG, embeddings, context, agents, evals, and guardrails.

• Understand the fundamental difference between building deterministic software and probabilistic AI experiences.

• Can translate rapidly evolving technical capabilities into valuable user experiences.

• Are comfortable defining and measuring quality where traditional acceptance criteria are insufficient.

• Think critically about when AI is – and isn't – the right solution.

• Can balance user value, model quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Experience with B2B SaaS is an advantage.

Experience with construction technology is welcome but not required. We have deep construction expertise within Dalux – for this role, we are particularly interested in adding strong AI product expertise to our organization.

**What To Expect At Dalux

**At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Ready for the next step?

**We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. You will collaborate with colleagues from Ukraine, Poland, Denmark and Germany, while gaining deep expertise in applied finance and modern software engineering practices.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will:

• Provide technical leadership in design, development, and testing.

• Define and own test architecture and quality strategy at team level.

• Balance active coding (C#, Angular, APL) with guiding automation initiatives

• Drive adoption of automation-first practices across the team.

• Ensure high-quality delivery by monitoring coverage, test metrics, and quality KPIs.

• Mentor and coach engineers in development, automation, and testing skills.

• Represent QA/Dev combined approach in cross-team forums.

• Collaborate with stakeholders (POs, TLs, architects) to align technical and quality goals.

• Conduct in-depth root cause analysis for complex defects and ensure preventive actions

• Advocate for and implement improvements in tools, CI/CD pipelines, and engineering processes.

• Continuously assessing and improving engineering processes, recommending new tools and technologies to enhance productivity and software quality

• Represent the team in technical forums and contribute to cross-team knowledge exchange.

**What We Value

**

• We are looking for an engineer who has demonstrated leadership abilities

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering with combined Dev/QA responsibilities.

• Expertise in .NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.

• Known for impactful leadership, resulting in improved efficiency and project success among engineering teams

• Extensive background in test automation (E2E, API, Integration) and test strategy

• Solid experience in architecting and developing enterprise-scale applications.

• Extensive knowledge of Cloud and On-Prem infrastructures (Microsoft Azure experience)

• Deep expertise in CI/CD pipelines and tools (Git, TeamCity, Azure DevOps).

• Thorough understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and Domain-Driven Design

• Familiarity with XP practices (TDD, pair programming, continuous integration).

• Experience with relational databases (SQL).

• Readiness to learn APL, developing new features and debugging existing functionality, with full support from our team throughout the learning process.

• Proficient English communication skills (Upper-Intermediate or higher), both written and spoken

• Ability to mentor, motivate, and guide a team toward technical excellence and efficient delivery

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with Azure or similar cloud platforms.

• Background in FinTech or capital markets.

• Knowledge and experience in the financial domain, fintech, derivatives (options, futures, swaps, etc.) is an advantage.

**Benefits

**Competitive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide an excellent work & life balance: flexible work hours, a hybrid workplace model. On top of that, we have IP sprints where you have 3 weeks per quarter you can spend on mastering your skills as well as contributing to the company development. There is never just only one route - we practice an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process.

To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

We’re looking for a senior full-stack engineer with a strong interest in building AI-first products who enjoys owning problems end-to-end – from vague client needs and early hypotheses to production-grade systems that actually get used.

**What You’ll Do

**You’ll join The Tech Collective (our Data & AI hub, specifically), where we help organisations design, build, and operationalise data- and AI-driven solutions.

This role is tailor-made for a systems thinker and builder – someone who has shipped real products, taken responsibility for technical direction, and is motivated by creating pragmatic solutions that combine data, software, and AI.

You’ll work closely with experienced AI specialists who bring deep model and ML expertise, while you focus on building robust products and software around those capabilities.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• End-to-end solution ownership: designing and implementing full-stack applications from early concepts and prototypes to scalable, production-grade systems, including architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and cloud

• Modern full-stack development: building high-quality frontend and backend services, applying sound software engineering principles, and using AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully and critically

• AI-enabled product building: collaborating with AI specialists to integrate LLMs, retrieval pipelines, and agentic patterns into real products, and translating AI potential into solutions that make sense for organisations

• Data and systems thinking: designing data models, reasoning about distributed systems and trade-offs, and implementing event-driven or real-time features where they add value

• Observability and evaluation: experience setting up the right observability and eval tooling to establish traceability and iteratively improve on products

• Cloud, delivery, and collaboration: deploying and operating solutions in cloud environments, balancing speed, robustness, and security, and working closely with clients and stakeholders to create tangible business impact

**What You’ll Bring

**We’re looking for someone with an AI builder mentality and 5+ years of hands-on full-stack experience, who is comfortable owning applications end to end – from frontend and backend to data and deployment.

You don’t need to tick every box, but you should recognise yourself in most of the following:

• Strong full-stack foundation: solid skills in TypeScript and/or Python, with experience building and shipping production systems

• Mentoring experience: helping other developers through technical sparring and code reviews

• Outward curiosity: actively seeking to understand client problems in detail and working in close collaboration with them to solve them

• Ownership and leadership: a track record of building substantial solutions from scratch (e.g., startup, scale-up, or personal ventures), taking responsibility for outcomes, and leading technical direction without relying on formal authority
